context: The trades for this task are deterministic from the seed: the same seed always yields the same year of trades, with 7 or 8 trades, three sales, days 1-365, prices in cents, and tickers from a fixed set; the trade list is supplied once the seed is given. A buy's shares are numbered from 1 upward and each starts with a basis equal to the buy's price_cents. Process sales in day order; a sale sells the earliest-bought shares of its ticker still held (lowest share number first). A sold share is a loss share when its basis exceeds the sale price, loss = basis - price; only loss shares take part in matching, and a share sold at its basis has no loss. A replacement for a sale on day D is a share of the same ticker from a buy on day B with |B-D| <= 30 (30 counts, 31 does not); later buys count, unsold shares of the same buy count, but shares already sold or already absorbing a loss do not, and each share absorbs at most one loss ever. Match the sale's loss shares in the order sold, each to the first free replacement: earliest buy first, lowest share number first; loss shares with no replacement stay allowed. A matched loss is wholly disallowed and added to that one replacement share's basis, with no rounding or proportions, so a later sale of that share has the raised basis and can itself be a loss share and be matched in turn. A match {sale_id, buy_id, shares} takes the sale's next loss shares onto the next free shares of that buy; matches for a sale should be listed earliest buy first. For each sale report realized_cents = total gain over all its shares after disallowed losses are left out (negative means a net loss) and disallowed_cents = sum of the losses disallowed for that sale (0 if none); total_realized_cents is the sum of every sale's realized_cents. List every sale exactly once; the order of the sales in the list does not matter.
